implementation.targetScope: CSS string and identifier function API, all documented options and mutable defaults; command-line wrapper is not implemented

source: Written from README contracts, CSS escape syntax and black-box results. No upstream runtime source read or copied. One code-point scanner decides delimiters between emitted tokens; safe ASCII text returns directly.
changes: Leading digits are escaped once when escapeEverything and isIdentifier are combined; upstream duplicates the digit escape tail.
A single hyphen is escaped as a valid identifier.
Inherited options are ignored; non-string input throws a named TypeError. UTF-16 lone surrogates and NUL retain upstream serialization, whose interpretation follows CSS replacement-character rules.

caller.verified: Unchanged class, namespace and quoted attribute mutation/round trips with synthetic selector names; native Chrome identifier selection and CSS string parsing. No app dependency changes or adoption claim.
